items.body: South Korean indie favourites JANNABI are finally heading to Singapore for the very first time. Presented by FriedRice Entertainment, the duo’s JANNABI 1st Asia Tour : Sweat & Stardust in Singapore will take place on 13 August at Capitol Theatre, marking the Singapore stop of the band’s first-ever Asia tour. Comprised of Choi Jung-hoon and Kim Do-hyung, JANNABI have become one of Korea’s most beloved indie acts thanks to their nostalgic chamber pop sound and emotionally resonant songwriting. Since debuting in 2014, the band have steadily built a devoted following through releases that explore themes of youth, love, and growth. View this post on Instagram A post shared by FriedRice Entertainment (@friedrice.live) The band are perhaps best known for their breakout hit ‘for lovers who hesitate’, which took home Song of the Year at the 17th Korean Music Awards in 2020. Their live performances have also earned acclaim for their immersive storytelling and distinct concepts, with their futuristic concert All the Boys and Girls 2125 winning the Grand Prize for Best Concert at the 12th EDAILY Culture Awards. Fans attending the Singapore show can also look forward to exclusive fan benefits. VIP ticket holders will receive priority entry to the standing pen, priority merchandise access, a JANNABI guitar pick, and a chance to win a signed concert poster. All ticket holders will also receive a commemorative postcard. Tickets go on sale from 2 PM (SGT) on 3 June via Ticketmaster Singapore.

items.body: The glitz and glamour of red carpet season rages on as the 52nd American Music Awards (AMAs) carpet receives some of the industry's rising stars and iconic legends for a night of recognition and celebration. This year's instalment of the awards spotlights more Asian artists, with several K-pop artists being nominated across categories outside of the usual Favourite K-pop Artist category. This year's awards feature two K-pop-specific categories, including Best Male K-Pop Artist and Best Female K-Pop Artist. The former category sees K-pop royalty such as ATEEZ, BTS, ENHYPEN, Stray Kids, and TOMORROW X TOGETHER nominated, with the latter category presenting an electrifying ensemble of the most fiery female groups, including aespa, BLACKPINK, ILLIT, LE SSERAFIM, and TWICE. Winners BTS However, Asian artists are not just confined to these two categories this year. This year marks a monumental moment with Asian artists winning among international nominees as well. Beginning with one of the biggest wins in a major category, BTS dazzles the crowd as their lead single 'SWIM' from their comeback album ARIRANG won the Song of the Summer category. During their speech, RM shared, “Thank you so much for giving so much love to ‘SWIM’. When we made this album, we felt a lot of pressure and tried to figure out what kind of music felt the most like us right now. But the one thing we believed in was that we have to keep challenging ourselves and keep moving forward.” V then added, “To everyone out there who keeps swimming, we send you our love and support.” BTS accepts the award for Song of the Summer for "SWIM" at the #AMAs pic.twitter.com/UjTe8Lor11 — Variety (@Variety) May 26, 2026 Nominated against some of this year's most viral hits, like the shimmering allure of Harry Styles' 'American Girls', the sassy energy of PinkPantheress and Zara Larsson's 'Stateside', and even the haunting rhythm of Tame Impala and JENNIE's 'Dracula'. That was certainly not the only time BTS would be on stage to accept an award, as they had a clean sweep, winning all the categories they were nominated for. They claimed their throne as the kings of K-pop as they won the award for Best Male K-Pop Artist. Rounding off their series of wins for the evening, they prove that they are not just a force to be reckoned with within the K-pop scene, but in the global music scene as well, claiming the coveted Artist of the Year award, marking a pivotal moment that reinforces their influence even after their temporary hiatus. RM thanked ARMYs once again for their support as he says, "...Our biggest thanks and gratitude always goes to ARMYs all over the world." Because of the fans, @bts_bighit is taking home the biggest award of the night! Congratulations on Artist of the Year at the #AMAs! 🎉 pic.twitter.com/P9GJaZBpHV — American Music Awards (@AMAs) May 26, 2026 HUNTR/X (EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami) Soaring through more extremely deserving wins, the air went still as the nominees were listed for the prestigious Song of the Year category. While everyone eagerly awaited to know which song soundtracked 2025 and 2026, the crowd erupted into cheers as the empowering anthem 'Golden' from Netflix's KPop Demon Hunters emerged victorious. The Singing Voices of HUNTR/X: EJAE, Audrey Nuna, Rei Ami are your Song of the Year winners for "Golden" 🎶 #AMAs pic.twitter.com/6P1R5VnwFq — American Music Awards (@AMAs) May 26, 2026 'Golden' also triumphed in the beloved Best Pop Song category against an all-star lineup of nominees that included Olivia Dean, Sabrina Carpenter, and Taylor Swift. The bold voices of EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami also had their moment to shine as they took home the award for Best Vocal Performance. With 'Golden' having sparked a viral TikTok trend centred around attempting its legendary high note, their win in the category felt especially well deserved. Last but not least, after winning every category they were nominated in at the AMAs, the official KPop Demon Hunters soundtrack secured the Best Soundtrack award. Not only did the win highlight the film’s expansive global reach, but it also symbolised the continued growth of K-pop culture beyond borders as audiences around the world embrace its appeal. KATSEYE In the name of spotlighting global groups, KATSEYE stepped up onto the stage to accept their award for the New Artist of the Year category. During KATSEYE’s acceptance speech, Sophia gave a heartfelt shoutout to BTS, thanking the group for inspiring them to represent their culture on a global scale. KATSEYE shouts out BTS for "inspiring us to represent our culture on a global scale" after winning Best New Artist at the #AMAs.(via CBS) pic.twitter.com/cDltrqc971 — Variety (@Variety) May 26, 2026 Known for their extremely vibrant and over-the-top visuals, KATSEYE also took home the amazing Best Music Video award for 'Gnarly'. "You could describe everything with one single word," and it would be awesome, as KATSEYE also had a clean sweep receiving the award for Breakthrough Pop Artist. Their wins are a testament to their rapid rise from their debut to dominating festival stages, and now winning awards with their explosive sonic style and undeniable ability to deliver hit after hit. TWICE One of the most monumental wins of the evening went to TWICE, who emerged victorious in the Best Female K-Pop Artist category. With their warm, lovable charm and confident flair, it comes as no surprise that the musical powerhouses clinched the award as they continue to carve out their own path and expand their artistry with each new release. Fans online rejoiced over the group’s win, flooding social media with congratulatory messages and celebrating the landmark moment. Iconic performances & moments The AMAs would not be complete without the reverberating beats of amazing performances. Select nominees staged amazing shows that got the crowd on their feet as they jammed out to some of the greatest hits on the charts right now. Needless to say, BTS delivered a powerful performance that served as a bold statement declaring, “We’re back, and we’re here to stay.” Still riding the high of their comeback era, they channel the passionate fire of ARIRANG, infusing their inner edge and rebellion as they opened the AMAs with 'Hooligan'. The striking track was the perfect way to kick-start the awards ceremony as its carefree nature was bound to spark excitement within the nominees and audiences. 📢 WATCH THIS WATCH THIS 📢 @bts_bighit goin' hooligan at the #AMAsTune in NOW on @cbs and @paramountplus! pic.twitter.com/l17LithXLp — American Music Awards (@AMAs) May 26, 2026 BTS also took the stage later to present SZA with her AMA for the Best Female R&B Artist. During her speech, she expressed that it was nice to officially meet the powerhouse group formally in person, sharing, "It's crazy that this is the moment, so I had to take this moment to just let this be the moment." SZA fangirls meeting BTS at #AMAs pic.twitter.com/m9ydMYVSxJ — Deadline (@DEADLINE) May 26, 2026 Later on during the ceremony, the crowd got their 'PINKY UP' as KATSEYE strutted onto the stage, performing their latest hit single with its booming techno rhythm that created an exhilarating sonic atmosphere within the arena. The quintet blew audiences away with their energetic choreography, making their performance one of the most memorable moments of the awards. KATSEYE performed “Pinky Up” at the AMAs tonight and completely owned the stage.KATSEYE GOES WILD AT AMAs#KATSEYE_AMAs pic.twitter.com/wiMvNw0DZ8 — KATSEYE B✶SE (@KATSEYEBASE) May 26, 2026 With more winners yet to be announced, these victories mark a huge shift in the industry as Asian artists are increasingly being recognised on global stages, proving that their music, artistry, and cultural impact continue to resonate far beyond borders. From electrifying performances to landmark wins by acts such as BTS and KATSEYE, this year’s American Music Awards reflected a growing era of inclusivity and international representation within mainstream entertainment.

items.body: BABYMONSTER are officially bringing their second world tour to Singapore this November, and ticketing details are finally here. The K-pop girl group will perform at the Singapore Indoor Stadium on 28 November as part of the 2026–27 BABYMONSTER WORLD TOUR ‘춤 (CHOOM)’. The upcoming show follows the success of the septet’s sold-out Singapore concert in 2025 during their debut HELLO MONSTERS world tour. Organised by Live Nation Singapore, the concert marks one of the group’s Asia stops for the ongoing world tour, which will also see the act perform across cities including Bangkok, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur, Taipei, Hong Kong, Sydney, and Melbourne. BABYMONSTER are currently promoting their third mini album, 춤 (CHOOM), which was released on 4 May. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Live Nation SG (@livenationsg) Ticket prices for the Singapore concert are priced at S$358, S$348, S$308, S$298, S$258, S$228, S$188, and S$168, excluding booking fees. VIP ticket holders will receive: Priority entry for standing or seated sections Access to the pre-show soundcheck party A commemorative VIP laminate and lanyard Limited-edition VIP gift Exclusive photocard set MONSTIEZ MEMBERSHIP holders can register for the Weverse presale from 26 May, 12 PM to 29 May, 11:59 PM. The Weverse presale will then take place on 8 June, from 10 AM to 11:59 PM. Mastercard and Trip.com presales will run on 9 June, from 10 AM to 11:59 PM, while the Live Nation presale is set for 10 June, from 12 PM to 11:59 PM. General ticket sales begin on 11 June at 12 PM via Ticketmaster Singapore.

items.body: The Click Five are heading back to Singapore for another night of pop-rock nostalgia. Following two sold-out shows at Capitol Theatre in 2025, the American band are set to return with the 29 August stop of their For Lovers Tour at Arena @ EXPO. Known for defining the soundtrack of the early 2000s with irresistible hooks and singalong-ready choruses, the band’s upcoming Singapore show is expected to be their biggest one in the country yet. Fans can look forward to live performances of hits including 'Jenny', 'Just the Girl', and 'Catch Your Wave', alongside other fan favourites from across their catalogue. The Boston-formed outfit first built a massive fanbase across Asia during their original run, becoming one of Myspace’s most-viewed bands at the height of their popularity. Their 2025 Southeast Asia comeback tour reignited that connection with longtime fans, with tickets for their Singapore dates reportedly selling out within hours. As part of the For Lovers Tour, the band will also be offering VIP packages and experiences for concertgoers. items.body: Hans Zimmer is set to return to Singapore with his brand-new live production, Hans Zimmer Live – The Next Level World Tour 2026, happening on 7 October at the Singapore Indoor Stadium. Presented by AEG Presents Asia, Semmel Concerts, and RCI Global, the upcoming show marks the legendary composer’s first performance in Singapore since 2019. Known for transforming film scores into immersive live spectacles, Zimmer’s latest production promises an even more ambitious cinematic experience, featuring electronic sound design, large-scale orchestration, spectacular lighting, and a brand-new stage concept. View this post on Instagram A post shared by AEG Presents Asia (@aegpresentsasia) Speaking about the tour, Zimmer shared: “I want fans to feel like they’re at a rave party or riding a roller coaster. For me, every show is a new voyage of discovery.” Fans can expect fresh arrangements from some of Zimmer’s most iconic film scores, including music from Pirates of the Caribbean, The Lion King, The Dark Knight, Interstellar, and Dune. The setlist will also feature selections from Dune: Part Two and F1®: The Movie. View this post on Instagram A post shared by AEG Presents Asia (@aegpresentsasia) The Singapore stop is part of Zimmer’s wider Asia run, which will also see the composer perform in cities such as Yokohama, Kaohsiung, Taipei, Beijing, Hangzhou, Chengdu, and Guangzhou. Tickets will go on sale via SISTIC on 2 June from 10 AM onwards.

items.body: Looking back on a glorious 11-year journey, the sun isn't setting anytime soon on SEVENTEEN as they celebrate their anniversary, sharing warm and heartfelt messages with CARATs on Weverse. Earlier this year, S.Coups, Jeonghan, Joshua, Jun, Hoshi, Wonwoo, Woozi, DK, Mingyu, The8, Seungkwan, Vernon, and Dino all renewed their contracts with PLEDIS Entertainment, strengthening their bond with fans as they make a pledge to be their favourite idols for as long as they can. With many more milestone anniversaries on the horizon, CARATs celebrate this landmark moment by sharing clips of old performances and iconic moments that stay etched in their minds. As fans reminisce about the journey of the group so far, the members took to Weverse to share their messages of appreciation, joining in on the nostalgic reflection of the paths they've forged. Although he is currently serving his national service, Hoshi expresses his excitement to complete his duties and reunite with the band to continue performing and creating new bangers for fans to rock out to. The8 echoes a similar sentiment as he expresses his love by saying, "It’s been 11 years. Thank you for always being by our side, thank you to all the members for getting this far, it hasn’t been easy. Because of the time we’ve spent together, we've long become a part of each other’s lives. We hope to continue creating many more memories together in the future. Thank you for your unwavering love." As each member expresses their gratitude for the support from CARATs for the past 11 years, they look forward to an even more eventful future as SEVENTEEN. The group anticipates more new hits, even bigger performances, and new endeavours as they continue to preserve the original energy and passion that they have served up since their debut.

items.body: Lola Amour celebrated a decade of music with a sold-out two-night anniversary event at 123 Block in Mandaluyong on 22 and 23 May, drawing over 2,500 fans across the weekend for a heartfelt full-circle celebration of the band’s journey. Originally planned as a one-night show on 23 May, overwhelming demand prompted the addition of a “Pre-Game” night on 22 May — with both dates eventually selling out. Across the two evenings, fans were treated to performances from Any Name’s Okay, Jan Roberts, Shirebound, and The Ridleys, alongside a career-spanning set from Lola Amour themselves. Beyond the live performances, attendees also explored the Lola Amour Museum, an exhibit showcasing memorabilia from the band’s 10-year history. Among the featured pieces were the band’s 2017 Wanderband Champions trophy, their Japan Ruby Award from the 2025 Music Awards Japan, and the iconic “Shiela” costume from the ‘Raining in Manila’ music video. The anniversary weekend was packed with memorable moments that highlighted the band’s close relationship with its fans and collaborators. One standout performance saw Sof of Any Name’s Okay join the band for ‘Clarity’, while a chaotic and crowd-pleasing cover of ‘Mr. Brightside’ brought together Jan Roberts, Renzo of Any Name’s Okay, Ivo Impreso of PLAYERTWO, and former road manager Peter onstage. During the set, bassist Manu crowd-surfed through the audience, earning one of the loudest cheers of the weekend. Fans also witnessed a playful moment during ‘Lambing’, where frontman Pio transformed into a human disco ball with a mirrored helmet during the song’s instrumental break. The emotional high point of the celebration came during a reunion of the bands that would eventually form Lola Amour. Former members Raymond King and Martin Kim returned to perform as Decaf, while current trumpeter Angelo Mesina briefly returned to his original role as drummer. Joxx Perez and Renzo Santos also made surprise appearances as Sinigang Na Baboy. To close the weekend, all former members joined Lola Amour onstage for the final chorus of ‘Raining in Manila’, creating a powerful moment that encapsulated the band’s decade-long journey from playing small venues to becoming one of the Philippines’ biggest acts. Part concert, part reunion, and part tribute to the community that has supported them since the beginning, Lola Amour’s anniversary weekend felt less like a retrospective and more like a celebration of everything still ahead for the band.

items.body: Filipino-Canadian alt-pop breakout MICO is finally heading to Singapore for his first-ever show in the city. The singer-songwriter will bring his Running From a Feeling Tour to Foo Chow Hall on 19 November for what’s set to be one of his biggest regional performances yet. Presented by LAMC, the upcoming concert arrives fresh off MICO’s sold-out international tour run, with the artist continuing to build momentum through his emotionally driven blend of pop-punk nostalgia and modern alt-pop sounds. Inspired by acts like Fall Out Boy, 5 Seconds of Summer, and The All-American Rejects, MICO has quickly carved out a space for himself with tracks such as ‘HOMESICK’, ‘DREAMBOY’, ‘and cut my hair’. View this post on Instagram A post shared by L.A.M.C. (@lamcpresents) The 23-year-old artist, whose real name is Miguel Veloso, first gained traction through bedroom recordings and online performances before signing with Columbia Records. Since then, he has amassed a devoted fanbase online — affectionately known as “amicos” — while releasing his debut album When the lights turn on. Fans can expect soaring singalongs, heartfelt storytelling, and a cathartic live experience when MICO takes the stage this November. According to the press release, the show will spotlight music from When the lights turn on alongside fan-favourite singles that helped propel the artist’s rise in the alt-pop scene. Tickets (general sales on 28 May) for the Singapore show are priced at S$138 for General Admission, while group bundles for three or more are available at S$128 per ticket. Sign up for pre-sale (27 May) here.

items.body: RIIZE keep their musical momentum going as they soar into a warm and summery new chapter with their upcoming album II, hitting the charts on 15 June. Following the successful release of their debut full-length album ODYSSEY, the sextet explores a new sonic direction with this project, reinforcing their versatility with each release. Spanning six tracks, II is a statement of raw artistic authenticity with a straightforward message that emphasises the importance of staying true to yourself. At the heart of the album is the title track 'Do Your Dance', that doubles down on the key message of the album while blending their signature musicality with layered sonic textures and evocative storytelling through the lyrics. RIIZE empower fans, telling them to own their spotlight with confidence through the signature vocals that have defined the group's sound, delivered with the maturity of a group entering its fourth year. RIIZE unveiled an official schedule detailing each upcoming release as part of the mini album. Fans can look forward to the string of teaser content, including trailer videos and images, a preview of the title track, and music video teasers set for release from 25 May onwards, leading up to the record's release on 15 June. With II, RIIZE continue to cement their place as one of K-pop’s most exciting rising acts, balancing experimentation with the signature sound that fans have come to love. As anticipation builds toward the album’s release, the project promises to usher in another defining era for the group, one fuelled by confidence, growth, and a fearless embrace of their evolving artistry.

items.body: The ball flies toward the goal and Nike scores with their absolutely insane lineup of legendary musicians and sports players for the Universe of Football campaign that launches before the FIFA World Cup 2026. While this year's instalment of the major sports event has had a heavy emphasis on music, with the first-ever halftime shows and multiple theme songs being released, Nike leans into the fusion of sports and music by highlighting stars from each "field" in their campaign. They announced the artists and sports professionals featured in the campaign with a series of autographed Polaroids. Fresh off her electrifying release of the World Cup 2026 anthem 'Goals', BLINKs were sent into a frenzy when they saw their favourite K-pop princess featured in the list of artists. Comments were flooded with love for LISA, with many saying they can't wait for further updates and announcements. The star-studded lineup also featured global heavyweights such as Drake, the ICEMAN keeping it cool with his surprise three-album release, alongside Central Cee, Kim Kardashian, Serena Williams, Cristiano Ronaldo, Travis Scott, Mbappé, and many more. Blending the worlds of music, fashion, and football into one spectacle, Nike’s Universe of Football campaign captures the larger-than-life energy surrounding the upcoming FIFA World Cup 2026. With an all-star cast, the campaign further cements this year’s tournament as not just a sporting event, but a global cultural moment fuelled by entertainment and creativity.
